description: Changes: puts one cancelled or no-show stay back to booked, when its dates have not passed and a room of its type is free. Previews first: the first call shows the change and makes nothing. Reinstates a cancelled or no-show stay whose dates have not passed. Refused when a night still ahead has no free room of its type, and for a stay booked on Expedia or Booking.com. First call without confirm: a preview, nothing changes; then call again with the same values, confirm true and preview_id. Needs the owner's sign-in.

confirm.description: true to go ahead with the change shown in the preview
